page.overview:
Who is Achilles Milo?

He was a member of the W.O.R.M.S.. Like the rest of the members, he was arrested by the Super Friends after W.O.R.MS. leader Lex Luthor called them under the ruse as a chance for his comrades to showcase their technology.
